description: Calculate the adsorption energy of atomic H on the Ni(111) surface.
user_prompt: Calculate the adsorption energy of atomic hydrogen H on the Ni(111) surface (FCC, Fm-3m). Report the final adsorption energy Eads (in eV), defined as Eads = E(slab+H) - E(slab) - E(H).

references: Greeley & Mavrikakis, J. Phys. Chem. B 109, 3460 (2005)
Ferrin, Kandoi, Nilekar & Mavrikakis, Surf. Sci. 606, 679 (2012)
method.modeling: Ferromagnetic Ni(111) slab with at least 4 layers, vacuum >= 15 Angstrom, and a 3x3x1 or larger surface supercell; adsorb atomic H at the fcc hollow site. Reference the adsorption energy to the clean Ni(111) slab plus an isolated gas-phase H atom.
method.rationale: Value is the electronic binding energy for fcc-hollow surface H on Ni(111) at 0.25 ML in Greeley & Mavrikakis 2003, written in the negative Eads convention used by this benchmark. The +/-0.30 eV absolute tolerance covers coverage, k-mesh, slab-thickness, magnetic initialization, and atomic-H reference sensitivity.
